subject: SIG: Compact SDLC evidence pack — code review & CI controls
messages:
From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@sig-assess.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: alice.murray@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — compact SDLC evidence (code review, CI/CD, secrets, change mgmt)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call today. As part of the SIG intake for FinBank we need a compact evidence bundle that demonstrates production-grade SDLC controls. To keep this scoped and reviewable for the assessor, can you provide a single package (PDF index + redacted artifacts) with the following:

- Code review sampling (PR IDs, reviewer roles, redacted diffs where necessary)
- CI/CD job definitions and recent build run IDs (redacted logs acceptable)
- Secrets management policy and one example of transient secret issuance/rotation (command traces or runbook excerpts)
- Change management approvals for a recent minor release (ticket numbers, approver list)
- A short narrative (~1 page) describing how these pieces map to SIG control objectives

Deadline: target deliverable by EOD 2028-07-22 if possible.

If anything needs to be split up (e.g., legal redactions), call that out in the index and we can request follow-ups.

Thanks — Priya
SIG Assessor
pri ya.nair@sig-assess.com

(Attachment request: prefer an index PDF and attachments as separate files; small zips are fine)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@sig-assess.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — compact SDLC evidence (code review, CI/CD, secrets, change mgmt)

Priya — thanks, we can get that over. I'll assemble a compact index and attach a redacted artifact set. Marissa (Platform) and Irene (Security) are looped in for the artifacts and runbook excerpts. Quick clarifications:

- For code review sampling do you want the actual PR diffs redacted or just PR metadata (author, reviewers, approval timestamps)? We can provide both but diffs will be redacted to remove any customer data.
- For CI/CD: we will export the last 5 successful pipeline runs for the component that serves inference. Logs will be redacted for secrets and customer payloads.
- For secrets rotation: we have an ephemeral token policy (30m runners) and quarterly KMS key rotation — we will include a screenshot of the rotation schedule and a sample rotation job output.
- Change mgmt: provide one minor release ticket (JIRA: FB-4271) with approval chain and a signed runbook entry.

Irene / Marissa: can you confirm the artifacts you will attach and whether there are any embargo items? If we need a short statement from Legal on redaction, I can request it but prefer to keep moving.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Security (acting)
Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching the initial bundle. See attachment stubs below and short notes inline.

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_sdlc_evidence_index.pdf (index + mapping to SIG control IDs)
- ci_build_log_samples.zip (5 pipeline run logs, redacted)
- code_review_sampling.csv (5 PR records with reviewers and timestamps)
- runbook_rotation_excerpt.txt (sample rotation job output, sanitized)

Quick artifact notes:
1) Code review: code_review_sampling.csv contains PR numbers, authors (internal IDs), reviewer list, LGTM timestamps, and linked Jira change ticket. We redacted diff content and replaced customer references with <REDACTED>.
2) CI/CD: the zip contains job definitions (YAML) and sanitized stdout for the build steps. Build IDs: ci-2028-07-03-1143, ci-2028-07-09-2105, ci-2028-07-11-0817, ci-2028-07-13-1730, ci-2028-07-14-0051.
3) Secrets: runbook_rotation_excerpt.txt shows the scheduled KMS rotation job, the audit log entry (redacted principal), and an example ephemeral runner token issuance event. Our ephemeral runner tokens are valid for 30 minutes; we include the issuance trace id: rt-20280711-5543 (redacted).
4) Change mgmt: linked JIRA FB-4271 (minor update to routing config) contains the approver list: @marissa_cole, @devops_oncall, @product_owner (we included the approval timestamps and signed runbook step).

If you need PR diff samples for one small internal-only repo (no customer data), we can attach a single redacted diff file. Otherwise the csv+index should meet the assessor's needs.

Next steps: Tessa / Irene, propose we send the zipped package and index by EOD Friday (2028-07-19). Priya — will that timeline work for FinBank intake?

—Marissa
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@sig-assess.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Murray <alice.murray@finbank.com>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — compact SDLC evidence (code review, CI/CD, secrets, change mgmt)

Thanks Marissa — this looks like a concise set and the index is helpful. Two quick follow-ups before assessor verification:

1) Can you provide an explicit proof artifact for periodic key rotation (KMS key IDs and rotation timestamps) for at least the last two quarters? A CSV export or audit log snapshot is fine.

2) For ephemeral runner tokens: please include the policy text that enforces the 30-minute TTL and the mechanism that prohibits reuse (we need evidence of token invalidation post-expiry). The runbook excerpt is good but we need the policy doc or policy file path.

If those two small items are included we should be able to proceed with the SIG verification. EOD Monday (2028-07-22) still works for our review window.

Also, if possible, add one screenshot from the CI dashboard that shows a successful pipeline with the run ID and artifact hash (screenshot with only internal IDs). That helps the assessor validate the linkage between PR->CI->release.

If you prefer, we can accept the additional items as a small second package (labelled "Supplemental rotation + policy").

Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

—Priya
SIG Assessor
pri ya.nair@sig-assess.com
